task_instruction: Add a standing kick attack to the existing player controller. Use the current `res://scenes/characters/player.gd` and `res://scenes/characters/character.gd` setup so that pressing `attack` while the player is walking triggers a dedicated `kick` state instead of the normal grounded `punch`, and starting the kick should stop the player's horizontal movement. Pressing `attack` while idle should still use the existing `punch` attack. Update `res://scenes/characters/character.gd` and `res://scenes/characters/player.gd` as needed so the new grounded kick behavior is represented by a `kick` state and animation mapping. Then update `res://scenes/characters/player.tscn` to add a `kick` animation that uses all valid frames from the 5th row of `res://assets/art/characters/player.png`, inferred from the spritesheet layout. The `kick` animation must include a `DamageEmitter.monitoring` property track that turns monitoring on during the attack and back off when it finishes, and it must use the existing `on_action_complete` callback so the player returns to the normal grounded state after the kick.
author_astra_first_failure: kick animation must enable DamageEmitter monitoring during the kick and disable it when the kick ends
local_official_message: kick animation must use all valid frames from the 5th row
